_note: Where the VACC is and which shares it mounts. Tracked on purpose, so a clone knows the lab-wide facts. Who you are on it is NOT here: that lives in GUI_logs/.vacc.json, which git ignores.
_path_map: A share this lab keeps recordings on, and the path the cluster mounts it at. Measured: 2732 of 4574 recorded paths are on bigdata_jbarry, so most recordings need no transfer at all. A drive letter is NOT a rule here -- Y: means different things on different machines and is discovered per machine.
_shared: The lab's shared space on the cluster. One account owns it (Shahriar's, sakhava1); everybody else reaches it with their own netid, and Jarvis says who to ask when an account is refused. Jarvis Data under it is where uploads go, mirrored as <project>/<mouse>/<recording>/. Processing space: scratch may be purged, and the local copy stays the source of truth.
_temp: The lab's temporary space (gpfs3tmp), purged on a schedule. NOT unlimited: the lab group's quota there is 1000 GB (hard limit 1010 GB); an upload reads the room left before it sends anything. The other place an upload may go; it asks every time, scratch first.
